title: Protocol for generation of 3D bone marrow surrogate microenvironments in a rotary cell culture system
protocol: Prepare gelatin scaffolds from a cube of Spongostan™.
Cut the prepared gelatin scaffolds as needed.
Position the cut scaffolds in a 96-well suspension culture plate.
Seed HS-5 BMSC line onto the positioned scaffolds statically.
Under sterile conditions, open the blister containing the gelatin sponge and place it in a Petri dish.
Using a scalpel, cut the sponge into 3 slices of about 3 mm each.
With a 4 mm diameter punch, cut four equal cylinders per slice.
Sequester HS-5 BMSC cells from culture flasks by trypsin treatment.
Re-suspend detached HS-5 BMSCs in CTM (DMEM+10% FBS).
Count live HS-5 BMSCs using the trypan blue exclusion method.
Re-suspend the cells at a concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Place one gelatin scaffold per well in a 96-well, U-bottom cell suspension plate.
Seed 200000 HS-5 BMSCs per scaffold (corresponding to 20 μL of cell suspension).
Allow the entire volume (20 μL) to be absorbed by each sponge for uniform distribution.
Slowly pipette each scaffold three times with a p100 micropipette equipped with a tip whose extremity is cut off.
Incubate the 96-well plate in a humidified incubator at 5% CO2 and 37°C for 4 h.
Position the gelatin scaffolds in any well of the plate using forceps to prevent them from exiting the plate.
Fill the empty wells surrounding the scaffolds with PBS to prevent evaporation of the medium.
Take a new 10 mL Disposable High Aspect Ratio Vessel (HARV) and wash it by inserting 5 mL PBS through the open plug fill port.
With a 5 mL pipette, remove the PBS from the HARV vessel.
With a p200 micropipette, remove any residual PBS from the HARV vessel.
Through the plug fill port, add 600 μL of pre-warmed medium (DMEM+10%FBS) to the vessel.
Using a p100 pipette with a cut tip, carefully aspirate the scaffolds from the wells.
Transfer the scaffolds one by one through the plug fill port into the HARV vessels (up to 3 scaffolds/vessel).
Close the plug fill port.
Place the vessels in the vessel station of the bioreactor.
Set up the bioreactor inside the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Set the tachometer to a rotation speed of 7.5 rpm.
Leave the scaffolds overnight inside the vessel.
Retrieve MEC-1 cells or MM.1S cells from culture flasks.
Centrifuge the retrieved cells at 410 × g for 5 min.
Re-suspend MEC-1 cells in CTM (RPMI+10%FBS) to obtain a final concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Re-suspend MM.1S cells in CTM (RPMI+10%FBS) to obtain a final concentration of 2.5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Count cells by trypan blue exclusion method.
Re-suspend MEC-1 cells in CTM to obtain a final concentration of 15 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Re-suspend MM.1S cells in CTM to obtain a final concentration of 3.75 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 2 × 10^6 MEC-1 cells or 500 × 10^3 MM.1S cells through the plug fill port for each scaffold, obtaining a final volume of 800 μL for one scaffold or 1 mL for two scaffolds in the HARV vessel.
Add 6 × 10^6 MEC-1 cells or 1.5 × 10^6 MM.1S cells through the plug fill port to obtain a final volume of 1 mL in the HARV vessel.
Set rotation speed to 7.5 rpm and incubate for 5 hours at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Pre-warm CTM (RPMI+10%FBS).
Insert a sterile 5 mL syringe into a syringe port with the plunger removed to add pre-warmed CTM to the vessels.
Insert another 5 mL sterile syringe into the second port.
Fill syringe A with 5 mL of CTM.
With syringe B, slowly draw air out of the vessel and let medium enter from the second syringe.
Repeat steps ii-iii to fill the vessel with a total of ≅11 mL CTM.
Close the syringe ports and discard the syringes.
Put the vessel in the bioreactor in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Set the rotation speed initially to 7.5 rpm and then increase it up to 14 rpm to prevent sedimentation of scaffolds and maintain them in a free-fall condition.
Keep the scaffolds in culture in the bioreactor for 48–72 h.
If 3D culture continues, change the medium.
Remove air bubbles with two syringes placed in the syringe ports if necessary.
Monitor the color of the culture medium.
Change the medium if it turns yellow.
Insert a sterile 5 mL syringe into a syringe port and aspirate 2 mL of medium.
Discard the aspirated medium or store it for future analysis.
Open the second syringe port to allow air entry.
Aspirate remaining medium with the syringe, avoiding removal of scaffolds.
Insert another sterile 5 mL syringe (B) into a syringe port.
Remove the plunger from a sterile 5 mL syringe (A) and insert it into the second syringe port.
Fill the syringe (A) with CTM as explained in Step 3.7a.
Place the vessel back into the bioreactor for continued culture.
Optionally, recover cells from the medium by centrifuging at 410 × g.
Change the medium slowly and carefully to avoid disturbing scaffolds or creating turbulence inside the vessel.
Gently aspirate 2 mL of SN from the vessel using a syringe and transfer it to a 15 mL tube.
Open the plug fill port and pour the content of the vessel into a Petri dish or a 6-well plate.
Add 500 μL of Liberase™ 25 μg/mL in a FACS tube containing one scaffold, or add 1 mL for two or three scaffolds.
Incubate the tubes at 37°C for 10 minutes to digest the scaffolds completely.
Vortex the tube to facilitate cell disaggregation and re-suspend cells.
Add 500 μL of FBS to block enzymatic digestion, or add 1 mL if using 1 mL Liberase™.
Count cells by trypan blue exclusion method.
Centrifuge tubes at 410 × g for 5 minutes.
Wash cells with 1 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge again and discard the supernatant.
Use cells for subsequent staining and flow cytometry analysis.
If apoptosis detection is required, wash cells with Binding Buffer from the apoptosis detection kit.
Add 300 μL of PFA 4% per well in a 48-well plate for scaffold fixation.
Insert one scaffold per well at room temperature (RT) and let it fix overnight.
Wash scaffolds with Blocking Solution for subsequent staining and confocal analysis.
Lyse scaffolds for Western blot analysis by placing one scaffold in a 1.5 mL vial and lysing it with 100 μL/scaffold of Lysis Buffer for 30 minutes on ice (or at 0°C).
Place one scaffold in a 1.5 mL vial to lyse the scaffold for real-time PCR analysis.
Lyse one scaffold with 1 mL of TRIzol at RT and freeze it at −20°C.
Recover supernatant (SN) from the Petri dish or 6-well plate and place it in a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 410 × g for 5 minutes to pellet cells, then remove the supernatant and re-suspend the cells in 5 mL of PBS for counting by trypan blue exclusion dye.
Place the counted cells into FACS tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 410 × g for 5 minutes before staining them for flow cytometric analysis as explained previously.
Add supernatant (SN) from a well to another 15 mL tube, then aliquot it in 1.5 mL vials and store at −20°C for future ELISA or zymography analysis.
Stain cells retrieved from the scaffolds for flow cytometric analysis.
Digest the scaffolds using Liberase™ to retrieve the cells.
Analyze the stained cells by flow cytometry.
Incubate cells (≅ 500 × 10³ cells) and antibodies for 15 min at 4°C: for CD19-PC7, add 5 μL of antibody to 200 μL of cell suspension; for CD38-PE, add 0.5 μL of antibody to 200 μL of cell suspension.
Wash cells with 1 mL of washing medium, then centrifuge FACS tubes at 410 × g for 5 min.
Filter cells with a 35 μm cell strainer cap before running on a cytofluorimeter.
Run cells on a cytofluorimeter and analyze data.
Incubate cells and antibodies for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash cells with 1 mL of washing medium.
Centrifuge FACS tubes at 410 × g for 5 min.
Filter cells with 35 μm cell strainer caps.
Run cells on a flow cytometer and analyze data.
Fix scaffolds with PFA 4% overnight.
Wash scaffolds with Blocking Solution.
Permeabilize scaffolds with 500 μL Triton X100 0.3% in Blocking Solution for 20 min at room temperature (RT).
Wash scaffolds with 500 μL of PBS.
Stain scaffolds with primary and secondary antibodies.
Visualize stained scaffolds by confocal microscope (Leica TC sp5 or Olympus Fluo view).
Stain scaffolds with Phalloidin 565 diluted 1:50 in PBS for 1 hour at RT.
Stain scaffolds with Hoechst 33342 (5 μg/mL) for 1 hour at RT.
Visualize tumor cells stained with 2 μM Vybrant® CFDA SE Cell tracer before dynamic seeding using the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add drugs to 3D cell cultures.
Prepare one vessel as an untreated (Unt) condition.
Prepare one vessel for Ibr treatment.
Populate each vessel with 3 scaffolds populated with HS-5 BMSCs and CLL cells.
Retrieve 1–2 mL of medium from the vessels after 72 hours of dynamic culture using a syringe.
Aliquot retrieved medium into a 15 mL tube.
Minimize perturbation of scaffolds during medium retrieval.
Remove remaining medium containing cells that did not enter the scaffolds through the Plug Fill port.
Place removed cells/media in the 15 mL tube.
Count cells in supernatants to verify homogeneous distribution between vessels.
Centrifuge tubes for 5 minutes at 1500 rpm room temperature.
Discard cells that did not enter the scaffolds.
Retrieve medium from centrifuged tubes.
Gently re-add recovered supernatant inside the vessels through syringe ports.
Add Ibr 1 μM to the appropriate vessel if necessary, avoiding turbulence generation.
Prepare one vessel for Unt condition for Bortezomib (Btz) treatment.
Prepare one vessel for Btz treatment.
Populate each vessel with up to 3 scaffolds.
Add Btz diluted in approximately 300 μL of medium to obtain a concentration of 10 nM inside the vessel through one syringe port with a 1 mL syringe.
Retrieve both scaffolds and supernatant (SN) containing cells mobilized from the scaffolds after 5 hours of dynamic culture in the presence or absence of Ibr.
Digest scaffolds in FACS tubes by adding 500 μL of Liberase™ for 10 minutes at 37°C to retrieve cells.
Count cells present in the SN by trypan blue exclusion method in both untreated and treated conditions to evaluate mobilization induced by Ibr.
As a control, count cells inside the scaffold in both untreated and treated conditions.
Stain CLL cells present in the SN for CD19-PC7.
Wash cells with 1 mL of Binding Buffer and centrifuge tubes at 410 × g.
Discard supernatant (SN).
Stain cells with 5 μL of Annexin V for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Wash cells by adding 1 mL of Binding Buffer and centrifuging at 410 × g.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL of Binding Buffer.
Add 7 μL of Propidium Iodide (PI) immediately before running on a flow cytometer.
Stain cells inside the scaffold for CD73-APC and CD19-PC7 to evaluate the percentage of CLL cells.
Stain cells for AnnV and PI to assess viability.
Run stained cells on a flow cytometer to characterize composition and detect viability.
Retrieve scaffolds after 24 hours of dynamic culture in the presence or absence of Btz, as described in Step 5.16a and b.
Digest retrieved scaffolds using 500 μL Liberase™.
Count cells retrieved from scaffolds by trypan blue exclusion dye to evaluate percentage of dead cells.
Stain cells for anti-human CD38-PE and AnnV or CD38-PC7 and AnnV/PI for flow cytometric analysis.
